patterns.note: Full-screen content sections that replace each other on scroll, creating distinct visual states rather than a continuous flow.
Prominent use of bold, all-caps sans-serif typography for branding, headlines, and calls-to-action.
A monochromatic base palette of black, white, and grays, allowing product imagery to introduce the primary color accents.
Entire full-screen sections transition into view, replacing the previous section with a distinct visual snap or slide effect as the user scrolls.
The initial view is a full-screen product gallery, acting as a dynamic hero before transitioning to other content sections.

technique_notes: Implement full-screen content sections that snap to the viewport height. Use JavaScript (potentially with a scroll-snapping library or custom scroll detection) to transition between these sections, making them replace each other on scroll rather than allowing continuous scrolling. A fixed header element overlays these dynamic sections. A modal overlay for newsletter subscription appears on a specific trigger, such as scroll depth or time on page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, all-caps sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with a clean, legible body text for product details and descriptions.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (buttons, input fields, and image corners are consistently rectangular with no visible rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous spacing around full-screen sections and large text elements, creating distinct visual breaks between content blocks).

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the site's use of full-screen, distinct content sections that replace each other on scroll, creating a highly curated, almost gallery-like experience. This approach provides a unique rhythm and focus, making each content block feel like a deliberate presentation rather than part of a continuous flow.
